plugging.note: plugging = 1.5 x the contacts' sliding forces (p.135) plus the four couplings' springs (43 and 44.5 N without pressure, p.73, p.75); the couplings are vented before mating, so no pressure term; the crank's torque is the worst over the last 15 mm of travel, where everything engages

sources.widths: CombiTac uniq main catalogue (CT-Main-11014009-en) p.83 'Calculation of installation dimensions': carrier widths CT-E3-3 and CT-E3-2+PE 10 mm, CT-LMFB 6 mm, CT-10GBIT 22 mm, CT-E8-2 18 mm, CT-E-UCT08-2 42 mm, spacer CT-DIP4 4 mm; recess L1 = L + 22 / L2 = L + 33 for standard end pieces.
sources.carrier_depth: p.22, p.74: carriers 24 mm deep (mating axis); p.48: CT-10GBIT 34.9 mm deep, 28-32 mm tall, its pins 12 mm proud on the pin side, an RJ45 jack at the back.
sources.align4: p.80-81 and CombiTac align flyer (11014023-en) p.12-13: CT-HME-S/4 (pin part) and CT-HME-B/4 (socket part), zinc die-cast, 18 mm thick, 34.7 mm tall, 43 mm long, pin O9.8 mm 50.2 mm proud of the body (68.2 overall) with an insulating cap, pin axis 13.5 mm and screw hole 35 mm from the carriers' end; radial misalignment 4 mm, angular +-2 deg, 100,000 mating cycles. 'In a permanent installation application, the customer must provide a stable guide system'.
sources.cutout: p.84: panel cut-out for high-misalignment end pieces L + 54 x 41 mm, R5 corners, 2 x O4.2 mm holes at L + 70 mm.
sources.mated_gap: p.86: distance between the panels when mated Z = 25 mm (+1.5); p.87: largest gap between mated carriers 1-2 mm by contact (LCT06, LMFB 1 mm; CT3, SCT03, RJ45 2 mm; 10 Gbit 1.5 mm).
sources.ct3: p.26-29: O3 mm power unit up to 39 A, 3-pole CT-E3-3 and CT-E3-2+PE (one pole a protective earth); average sliding force 8 N per contact; 'Longer type of pin mates first'.
sources.lmfb: p.40-41: Last Mate First Break module CT-LMFB/B and /S, two contacts at the carrier's edge positions, 'intended for monitoring purposes, and show whether a CombiTac is fully connected or not'; 100 mA, 14 N spring force per contact.
sources.gbit: p.48-49: CT-10GBIT-RJ45/B and /S, Ethernet to 10 Gbit/s (Cat6A), 14 N average sliding force per module, 100,000 mating cycles.
sources.sct03: p.72-73: CT-B-SCT03 and CT-S-SCT03 in carrier CT-E8-2, G1/8 internal thread, SW12, 15 + 25 mm (socket) and 10.5 + 25 + 15 mm (plug), nominal bore 3 mm, 15 bar, 'leakproof, shut-off on both sides', spring force 43 N without pressure. p.61, p.70: fluid couplings 'can also be used for pneumatic applications, if a shut-off valve on both sides is needed'.
sources.lct06: p.74-75: CT-B-LCT06 and CT-S-LCT06 in carrier CT-E-UCT08-2, G1/4 internal thread, SW17, 20.5 + 24 mm (socket) and 11 + 24 + 8.5 mm (plug), nominal bore 6 mm, 15 bar, 8.48 L/min at 5 m/s, spring force 44.5 N without pressure, 135 N while mated at 10 bar; 'Connecting and disconnecting under pressure is prohibited.'
sources.safety: p.137: 'On permanently fixed installations, electrical contacts have to be placed above liquid couplings'; 'Connecting and disconnecting when live is permitted. Connecting and disconnecting under load is not permitted.' p.139: the socket side is touch-protected (IP2X) when disconnected.
sources.mating_speed: p.135: 'CombiTac was tested at a mating speed of 600 mm/min by an automatic process. Plugging force is equal to 1.5 times the sliding force.'
sources.hard_stop: p.82: screw CT-SHR-HS (M4) gives the end pieces a hard stop 'so that the force does not impact on the contacts during the mating process'.
sources.mgn12: HIWIN MGN12H miniature guide: rail 12 x 8 mm, block 27 mm wide, 45.4 mm long (hiwin.com MG series).
sources.igus: igus E2 micro energy chains, e.g. series E2.15 (inner height 15 mm, bend radii from 18 mm): our size, not a selected part.
